articles.title: Iran says 3 tankers strike mines and catch fire in Strait of Hormuz, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard claims a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of oil struck a naval mine, exploded and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz. This marks the third tanker incident on Friday after using unauthorized routes. The U.S. military denies the mine claims, stating primary transit routes are clear. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia says it intercepted a drone launched by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels near Mecca, a claim the Houthis deny. In other news, Qatari mediators return to Tehran for talks, and rescue teams search for missing people after flash floods in Syria.
